name: codeboarding-language-aware-api-surface-inventory
instr:
static_analyzer cannot record declaration access across languages or preserve it through merging, persistence, health reports, and documentation. Build an access inventory without changing declaration identities, source references, result buckets, reference-worthiness, exclusions, or unrelated output.

`static_analyzer.symbol_access` exposes `AccessKind`, frozen `AccessObservation`, and `AccessClassificationError`. `AccessKind` is a StrEnum; `AccessClassificationError` subclasses ValueError. Invalid names or locations and contradictory same-source classifications raise `AccessClassificationError`. `static_analyzer.symbol_access_index` exposes `AccessInventory`; `AccessInventory.__init__(self, observations=[])`, `merge(self, other)`, and `for_access(self, access)` deduplicate identical observations, reject conflicts, and filter in deterministic qualified-name order regardless of merge order. Each primary graph reference has exactly one observation; aliases and lookup-only declarations have none.

`classify_symbol_access(self, file_path, symbol, qualified_name, parent_chain, project_root)` covers `PythonAdapter`, `TypeScriptAdapter`, `JavaScriptAdapter`, `GoAdapter`, `JavaAdapter`, `PHPAdapter`, `CSharpAdapter`, and `RustAdapter`. Preserve qualified identities, exclusions, shared buckets, and collapsed implicit module names. Apply Python underscore and explicit-export rules; TypeScript and JavaScript exports, defaults, member visibility, and module locality; Go capitalization,
